method: For each row the reviewer read the NFC codepoint sequence from the committed quran-loc-surface index, hand-computed the clitic char span (first base letter + trailing combining marks), the base-letter span, the host remainder, the Uthmani-rasm skeleton letter count of the host, and the NFC reconstruction identity clitic+remainder == surface — then compared against the emitted attachment_geometry / surface_reconstruction_nfc / token_host_boundary fact values.
sample_selection: 20 of 454, chosen to cover every mechanical edge class: fused lam-lam wasla elision (1:2:2, 2:187:63, 4:11:5, 24:35:44), assimilation shadda inside the clitic span (2:2:7, 3:138:3, 23:20:9, 37:46:3, 43:56:4, 64:16:9, 70:16:2), tatweel-seated hamza host (2:34:5, 7:11:9, 23:20:9, 33:5:2, 43:56:4), dagger-alef host orthography (12:62:2, 37:46:3, 70:16:2), quranic annotation-mark alignment variant (2:118:23), alef-maqsura + madda host (20:14:11), diptote pilot row (2:34:5), and plain hosts (5:3:9, 9:120:3, 17:78:3).
result: 20/20 VERIFIED — every hand-computed span, boundary index, skeleton count and NFC reconstruction matches the emitted certified fact values exactly.
